# FG-AUTH-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `admission_denials_are_login_not_permitted` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このアカウントでは GitStation にログインできません。必要なら管理者に連絡してください。
- en: This account cannot sign in to GitStation. Contact the administrator if you need access.
- id: Akun ini tidak dapat masuk ke GitStation. Hubungi administrator jika Anda memerlukan akses.

## 原因 (cause)

The identity provider signed the person in, but `authorize()` refused the admission (`SessionCreate` on `Resource::Admission`, ADR-0021 §3): the ID token has no access client role (`resource_access.<client_id>.roles` does not contain `auth.oidc.access_role`), or the GitStation account it belongs to is disabled, or it is a bot or service account (those never sign in to the web). No session was issued and no user or identity link was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.auth.login_failed` carries `reason` (no_access_role, user_disabled, not_human), `action=SessionCreate` and, when the account is known, `user`. A person without the role is the expected case for someone outside the GitStation user group.

## 対処 (fix)

Grant the person the access role of the GitStation client in Keycloak (or the group that carries it) if they should use GitStation. A disabled account stays disabled until an administrator re-enables it (approved step, runbook user-offboarding). Bots and service accounts use tokens, not the web.
